name: Boon Of The Bright Sun
description: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+) You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase your Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30.

features.name: Daylight Presence
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you radiate a 30-foot Emanation of Bright Light that is sunlight. If any of the Emanation’s area overlaps with an area of Darkness created by a spell, that spell is dispelled. The Emanation lasts until you dismiss it (no action required), die, or have the Incapacitated condition.

features.name: Fortifying Light
features.description: When your Daylight Presence is active, at the start of each of your turns, you and allies you can see in your Daylight Presence gain 10 Temporary Hit Points.
